extracted.stage: Commercial claim for unpaid contract; funding sought for disbursements and counsel
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Finch & Varga Law asks whether Lodestar funds a commercial contract dispute, with around £26,000 needed for disbursements and counsel.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. So that we can consider it properly, could you confirm the jurisdiction of the proceedings, the value of the claim and any assets available as security, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, and details of your client and the intended use of the funds. Please note our products are focused on family law and probate matters in England and Wales, so we will review whether your matter falls within our scope. A member of the team will follow up once the above information is available.
